response.overview: Oliver has taken his six-year-old daughter Heather to the moors to experience a May Day celebration. However when Heather disappears, Oliver embarks on journey that leaves him unable to discern whether he is relapsing into mental illness or whether the devil has actually taken her. At the centre of this world is Dartmoor’s iconic and infamous figure of the Evil Rider, along with the pagan-like rituals of its inhabitants.
response.title: The Darkness of the Moor
